source_snapshot: Published pipeline source snapshot; not a claim of one immutable version throughout the study

agent.model_evidence: Pipeline parser and configuration default explicitly select this model; launcher passes --model. Also present in study-period source history.

environment_reported_by_thesis.note: The included uv.lock captures the published source environment, not proof of every historical worker dependency.

reproduction_limits: Fresh GitHub runs cannot be expected to reproduce identical populations or counts: repositories can become private, be deleted, renamed or patched, and workflows and dependencies can change. The released snapshot supports recomputation of the reported marginal results.
LLM nondeterminism and preview-model availability prevent exact reruns.
Repository identities and scanned commit hashes are intentionally withheld.
